tagline: A second look for citizen stream assessments. Riffle flags contradictions, explains why, asks the volunteer to re-check, and sends doubtful reports to a person. It never edits an answer.

title: Kraków Sponge (Gąbka Krakowa)
tagline: The city's water starts upstream. Open data and citizen observations turn drought evidence into transparent retention survey priorities for three rivers around Kraków.

title: RiverVision
tagline: RiverVision is a browser-first, human-reviewed stream photo assessment site. Works on both desktop and mobile

title: Aegis Aqua: AI-Assisted Stream Monitoring Rover
tagline: A rugged rover that uses visual inspection, environmental sensors, and human-verified AI to monitor urban streams and identify potential ecosystem risks.

title: DrainWatch: Stormwater & Litter Watch
tagline: A community action platform for residents and volunteers to report drainage and litter issues, confirm conditions, follow progress, and receive weather-aware guidance for healthier urban waterways.

title: StreamVoice
tagline: Your stream, Explained out loud

title: WatchDOG
tagline: Walkers and their dogs become an early-warning network for urban streams: forecasts + 30-second reports → human-approved advisories → FHIR hand-off to health services.

title: OneaqualHealth UI and UX improvement - Ripple
tagline: Ripple is a friendly, multilingual water-monitoring app that guides people through simple stream observations, works offline, and turns a few minutes of citizen input into useful data for researchers.

title: StreamCheck
tagline: An AI second pair of eyes for citizen stream assessments. It explains what it sees; the citizen decides.

title: Aquaverse
tagline: a living, pixel-art urban stream that shows how the health of the water, the wildlife and the people nearby rise and fall together.

title: CLINICASE
tagline: Elevator pitch: CLINI-CASE safely moves environmental and health data between systems using FHIR, human review, and governed AI—so the format can change, but the meaning does not.

title: Baseline-Break
tagline: Early warning system that detects when a river stops behaving normally.
